contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival.
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For Short notice / Last minute bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation.
contract.terms_text: RATE INCLUDES: Minimum stay should be 3 nights with Full board + Ayurveda treatments. FACILITIES & SERVICES: Accommodation on full board basis. All Ayurveda treatments are offered daily after doctor's consultation. Internal medicines will be prescribed by the doctor according to the body type (minimum 03 nights). Daily two hours and fifteen minutes ayurveda treatment. All treatments are offered in the villa and niwasa (treatment center). All meals catered according to the body constitution. One cookery demonstration (minimum 05-night stay). One music therapy (minimum 05-night stay). Daily yoga session in the morning. Swimming pool with jacuzzi jet nozzle. Pool Exercise Program 2 times per week (Fixed session). Ayurveda health report (minimum 03 nights). PROGRAMMES BY LENGTH OF STAY (no separate price printed; each includes the doctor's consultation and assessment of the bio-energetic type daily). 03 Nights soft Ayurveda Program: oil head therapy (shiroabyanga), oil body therapy (snehana), face therapy (vakthrabyanga), foot therapy (padabyanga). 05 Nights wellness delight Ayurveda Program: snehana, medicinal pudding fomentation (pindasweeda), shiroabyanga, pouring oil head therapy (shirodhara), medical wet peeling (Udwartha), vakthrabyanga, padabyanga, steam bath (sweeda), herbal bath (Droniavagaha). 07 Nights health care or Stress relief Ayurveda program: padabyanga, snehana, shirodhara, pindasweeda, vakthrabyanga, shiroabyanga, medical wet and dry peeling (Udwartha/Udgarshan), Droniavagaha, sweeda, medicated oil pouring over the body (Thailadhara). 14 Nights purification and revitalization Ayurveda Program: snehana, Thailadhara, padabyanga, shirodhara, sweeda, pindasweeda, vakthrabyanga, shiroabyanga, pouring milk body therapy (Kshiradhara), Udwartha, Droniavagaha, Udgarshan, eye treatment (Akshitharpana), milk rice therapy (Navarakizhi), purgation therapy (Virechana). 14 Nights Detoxification Ayurveda Program: snehana, Thailadhara, shiroabyanga, shirodhara, padabyanga, steam bath (sweeda kuti), pindasweeda, Udwartha, vakthrabyanga, Droniavagaha, Udgarshan, Akshitharpana, steam therapy (Nadisweeda), anima treatment (Sneha vasthi/Nirooha vasthi), nasal cleaning (Naysa), medicinal mouth wash, Virechana. 14 Nights Weight reducing Ayurveda Program: Udwartha, vakthrabyanga, Droniavagaha, Udgarshan, Nadisweeda, Sneha vasthi/Nirooha vasthi, snehana, shiroabyanga, shirodhara, padabyanga, sweeda kuti, pindasweeda, Virechana; nourishment diet programs are advice to be obtain from the doctor. 21 Nights Purification and rejuvenation Ayurveda Program: snehana, Thailadhara, shiroabyanga, shirodhara, vakthrabyanga, Udwartha, Droniavagaha, Udgarshan, Nadisweeda, Sneha vasthi/Nirooha vasthi, head wat peeling therapy (Sirasaleepa), padabyanga, sweeda kuti, pindasweeda, Naysa, medicinal mouth wash, Kshiradhara, Navarakiszi, Virechana. 30 Nights Special panchakarma Ayurveda Program: sweeda kuti, snehana, shiroabyanga, shirodhara, pindasweeda, Nadisweeda, padabyanga, Sirasaleepa, vakthrabyanga, Sneha vasthi/Nirooha vasthi, Udwartha, Droniavagaha, Udgarshan, Naysa, medicinal mouth wash (Kawalagdraha/Gandusha), powder decoction (Virechana), Kshiradhara, Navarakiszi, Akshitharpana, purgation therapy (Virechana). | LONG STAY OFFER: 01st November 2026 – 30th April 2027, 07 nights and above – 05% discount. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserve the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate. | Contact: +94 312 276 719, resv.ayurveda@jetwinghotels.com, fo.ayurveda@jetwinghotels.com.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Ayurveda Pavilions - Winter 2026-2027 (Revised).pdf" (7 pages), saved to the HOTEL RATES folder on 2 Oct 2026. One printed period (01 Nov 2026 – 30 Apr 2027, "All Market"), SGL and DBL per room per night on Full board + Ayurveda treatments. The whole sheet is a minimum-3-night package: min_stay 3 is set on the plan, the season and as a restriction, but the rate lookup does NOT enforce it — staff must check the length of stay. The Ayurveda programmes (3 / 5 / 7 / 14 / 21 / 30 nights) are described without separate prices (terms). No child policy, gala dinner, triple or meal supplement is printed. Room names: "King Pavilions" matches the hotel's "king Pavilions"; "Queen Pavilions" is entered as the existing "Queens Pavilions"; "Classic Rooms" is new (the hotel has "Classic" and "Classic Rooms A/C").
